title: HBV-Lab agents experiment: code, run records and results
description: Code, agent transcripts, submissions and results of the HBV-Lab agents experiment on CAMELS-GB: automatic DDS calibration of HBV-Lab on 669 catchments and an AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5) calibrating HBV through the HBV-Lab MCP server on 95 representative catchments, every run audited.
